title: Look at what XLM just did
hook: XLM is setting up. Here's what my scanner caught.

segments.narration: XLM printed the week’s highest confluence score at 11.0 and appeared on the scanner two out of the last seven days, specifically on May 26 and May 28. Eight distinct signals aligned inside the convergence bucket. Volume inside the 20-period window expanded sharply while OBV showed stealth accumulation, indicating large players were absorbing supply without lifting price. RSI printed a bullish divergence against the prior swing low and sat inside the neutral-to-bullish zone, while CMF remained positive, confirming sustained buying pressure. Structurally, price carved a series of higher lows on the four-hour chart, and funding rates stayed negative, removing the long-squeeze fuel that often precedes fakeouts. Current price sits at 0.16862 with a 24-hour gain of 14.72 percent. The trade plan places entry at 0.16862, stop at 0.16015286 for a risk of roughly five percent, and three scaled targets: TP1 at 0.18132071, TP2 at 0.19402143, TP3 at 0.21095571. A daily close back below the May 26 low at 0.16015 would invalidate the higher-low structure and force a reassessment.
